status_definitions.official_ui_claim: Presented by the project UI but not independently proven by executable code.
status_definitions.ui_only: Visible in the UI but not backed by persistent application logic in the reviewed archive.
status_definitions.planned: Roadmap item or disabled Soon feature; do not describe as currently available.
status_definitions.verify_before_publish: Do not let the automated writer present this as fact until manually confirmed or externally verified.
status_definitions.blocked_auto_publish: Known inconsistency or high-risk claim; automation must not publish it as a current fact.

facts: The server validates Telegram Mini App initData using Telegram HMAC verification.
Telegram authentication data is accepted for up to 24 hours in the reviewed implementation.
User identity is derived from the verified Telegram user payload, not from a client-supplied user ID.

notes: The current application tracks APXN points before token transition/TGE.
The automated blog must describe this as an in-app points system, not as proof-of-work blockchain mining.
A successful claim atomically updates the balance and last_claim timestamp in Supabase.
A valid referrer must already exist and cannot be the same Telegram user.
The 1,000-point referral bonus in registration is credited to the newly referred user, while the inviter benefits through active-friend mining speed boosts.

daily_checkin.cycle_behavior: After day 7, the reward cycle returns to 100 points while the streak can continue.
daily_checkin.missed_day_behavior: If the previous check-in was not yesterday, the next successful check-in starts a new streak at day 1.
daily_checkin.duplicate_prevention: Atomic database row locking plus API-side duplicate gates.

daily_tasks.claim_frequency: Once per UTC day per task
daily_tasks.important_note: The reviewed implementation uses a delay before claiming from the UI, but the backend reward RPC records completion rather than independently verifying the external like action.

tasks.server_verification: No external X verification in reviewed implementation

referrals.active_friend_definition: A referred account whose last successful mining claim was within the previous 24 hours.
referrals.speed_bonus_per_active_friend: 5% of the inviter's base mining rate
referrals.country_role: Informational only; it does not affect authentication, rewards, mining or referral eligibility.

facts: The app can return total registered accounts.
The app can aggregate registered accounts by stored country code.
Country is recorded from Vercel's x-vercel-ip-country header when a new account is created and is not overwritten later merely because the user travels or changes networks.
Stats responses are CDN-cacheable for a short period in the reviewed API.

observed_behavior: The UI can request an EVM account from Binance Web3, MetaMask, Trust Wallet, OKX Web3 or a generic injected provider.
The UI accepts a manually pasted 42-character 0x BSC address.
The reviewed code only stores a shortened wallet address in React component state for display.
No API call or Supabase persistence for the wallet address was found in the reviewed archive.
wallet_linking.editorial_rule: Do not say that a wallet is permanently bound to the Telegram account or stored for future withdrawals until persistence exists and is verified.

boost_store.editorial_rule: Describe these as planned/preview features only; never imply that users can currently buy or activate them.

kyc_via_upgrade_unlocks.ui_claim: The UI states that users must unlock at least two stages in every boost level to pass KYC and qualify for APXN airdrop withdrawal.
kyc_via_upgrade_unlocks.technical_observation: No implemented KYC backend or purchase/unlock logic was found in the reviewed archive, and the boost buttons are disabled.
kyc_via_upgrade_unlocks.editorial_rule: Do not auto-publish this as an enforced current requirement until the backend and official policy are confirmed.

roadmap.editorial_rule: Always use future-tense/planned language for roadmap phases that have not been completed and never present roadmap timing as guaranteed.

tokenomics_and_contract_content.points_conversion_ui_statement: The in-app UI says APXN Points will be converted to APXN tokens during TGE and that the ratio depends on activity, upgrades and early-access status.
tokenomics_and_contract_content.editorial_rule: Describe conversion criteria as the current project policy/plan, not as a guaranteed conversion amount. Never invent a conversion ratio.

claims_requiring_manual_confirmation.claim: Verified and audited smart contract / audited via Thirdweb
claims_requiring_manual_confirmation.reason: The UI states this, but the reviewed application code does not itself prove an external audit.

claims_requiring_manual_confirmation.claim: No mint functions, no hidden taxes, fixed total supply
claims_requiring_manual_confirmation.reason: The UI states this; contract source/bytecode was not part of the uploaded Mini App archive.

claims_requiring_manual_confirmation.claim: Locked PancakeSwap/CEX liquidity or guaranteed decentralized trading
claims_requiring_manual_confirmation.reason: The application code does not prove liquidity locks, exchange relationships, or guaranteed trading.
README mentions CEX/DEX platforms 'such as Gate.io', but there is no evidence of an official Gate.io listing in the uploaded project.

claims_requiring_manual_confirmation.claim: Presale is currently active at $0.10 per APXN
claims_requiring_manual_confirmation.reason: The Tokenomics UI labels the presale as Active Phase and displays $0.10/APXN, but the same Roadmap says the phased presale starts in Q2 2027. On 2026-09-08 these statements conflict.

automation_editorial_rules: Use implemented facts as the highest-priority source for current product behavior.
Use the exact term APXN Points when describing the current in-app balance unless discussing the future token explicitly.
Never promise profits, guaranteed returns, guaranteed token price, guaranteed listing date, guaranteed exchange listing, or guaranteed point-conversion value.
Never state that pressing Claim performs blockchain consensus mining. Explain that the Mini App calculates and records ecosystem points programmatically.

Never present a roadmap item, Soon feature, disabled upgrade, staking feature, Testnet, Mainnet, presale, or CEX/DEX support as already live unless the knowledge base status is updated after verification.
Do not claim wallet persistence or withdrawal-address binding until a server/database implementation exists and is verified.
When discussing Telegram tasks, state that channel/group membership is server-verified; do not claim that X follows/likes are technically verified if the current code does not verify them externally.
Country information is informational and must not be presented as proof of identity, citizenship, KYC, or eligibility.
For tokenomics, use phrases such as 'the current APXN project plan states' where the data comes from project UI rather than executable reward logic.
Every article must contain useful educational content beyond promotion of APXN.
Include a non-financial-advice disclaimer on investment/tokenomics/presale articles.
Block auto-publication whenever an article requires a fact marked verify_before_publish or blocked_auto_publish.
